explore-tuner.title: Tune it
explore-tuner.prompt: Adjust the tuner until the transceiver sees 1.5:1 or better.
hints: Bring the capacitor down to about 100 Ω first.
Then bring the inductor up until the SWR dips.
explore-tuner.success: The tuner's reactance cancels the antenna's, and the radio sees 50 Ω. Full power again.

explore-ratio.title: The folded dipole
explore-ratio.prompt: Choose the transformer ratio that matches 300 Ω to 50 Ω.
